import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
plugin = pathlib.Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-opus55-581dd0e1-20261011/kk/0.23.0')
bundle = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='kk-preference-review-'))
base = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
files = ['README.md', 'reader.py', 'preferences.py', 'repository.py', 'tests/test_reads.py']
manifest = {'repository': str(root), 'base': base, 'selector': 'git diff --cached HEAD', 'candidate': 'Git index snapshot; unchanged worktree at capture', 'evidence': []}
for kind, rev in [('candidate', ':'), ('historical', base + ':')]:
    for name in files:
        spec = rev + name
        data = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', spec])
        dest = bundle / kind / name
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dest.write_bytes(data)
        dest.chmod(0o444)
        manifest['evidence'].append({'kind': kind, 'repository': str(root), 'revision': base if kind == 'historical' else 'index', 'original_path': name, 'blob': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', spec], text=True).strip(), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'original_lines': [1, len(data.splitlines())], 'omitted_or_redacted': 'none', 'path': str(dest)})
diff = bundle / 'staged.patch'
diff.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--no-ext-diff', 'HEAD', '--']))
diff.chmod(0o444)
commons = ['functional-review.md', 'shared-change-context.md', 'shared-review-scope-protocol.md', 'shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']
checklists = ['security-checklist.md', 'solid-checklist.md', 'code-quality-checklist.md', 'removal-plan.md']
criteria = [str(plugin / 'skills/review-code' / name) for name in commons] + [str(plugin / 'profiles/python/review-code' / name) for name in checklists]
loaded = {str(plugin / 'skills/review-code' / name) for name in commons} | {str(plugin / 'profiles/python/review-code' / name) for name in checklists}
assert len(criteria) == 8 and set(criteria) == loaded
manifest['instructions'] = criteria
manifest['diff'] = str(diff)
manifest['profile'] = {'name': 'python', 'triggered_by': 'content signal: authoritative .py extension for reader.py and tests/test_reads.py', 'checklists': criteria[4:]}
context = '''# Change context\\n\\nUser request: Review the staged preference ID normalization change in isolated mode; review only.\\nAuthority: candidate/README.md explicitly requires stripping surrounding ID whitespace while preserving resilient reads. Up to three attempts on TransientRead, first successful result returned, exhausted transient errors propagated, MissingPreference propagated on first attempt. Reads have no side effects.\\nBoundary: staged reader.py and tests/test_reads.py only, 10 additions and 4 deletions. Worktree matches index at capture. Public entry is Preferences.read; Repository.read_resilient owns retries; read_once performs one attempt.\\nBaselines: HEAD ''' + base + ''' versus captured index blobs (see manifest). HEAD is a local source baseline; no separate release/deployment baseline is named. No runtime services, migration or deployment policy is specified for this standard-library example.\\nScenarios to inspect against README: normalized and existing IDs; immediate success; transient then success on second and third attempts; three transients exhausted; immediate permanent missing; transient then permanent missing.\\nVerification: parent has read contracts and all source/test files but has not run tests at handoff. Capy searches for review patterns and Python idioms returned an empty knowledge base.\\n\\n## Task Scope\\nNo task scope available — review the diff on its own merits without assuming any feature-level design doc. No feature/task documents exist among tracked files.\\n\\nRejected approaches: none supplied.\\nEvidence limitations: no separate production/deployment data. PAL tools are unavailable, so only the independent code-reviewer can run. Do not substitute parent conclusions for independent review.\\n'''
context_path = bundle / 'context.md'
context_path.write_text(context)
context_path.chmod(0o444)
manifest['context'] = str(context_path)
manifest_path = bundle / 'manifest.json'
manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\\n')
manifest_path.chmod(0o444)
print(json.dumps({'bundle':str(bundle), 'manifest':str(manifest_path), 'criteria_count':len(criteria), 'loading_ledger_missing':sorted(set(criteria)-loaded), 'context':str(context_path), 'candidate_files':files, 'historical_revision':base}, indent=2))
PY"
